At request of the parties, the matter is taken up for settlement before the National Lok Adalat.
Both the parties are present.
Mr.D.Nitin, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr.V.P.Balaji, learned counsel for respondents are present.
After mutual discussion, negotiation, mediation and conciliation between both parties, they arrived at a compromise to settle the matter as follows.
TERMS OF SETTLEMENT
The respondents/petitioners filed the claim petition before the trial court.
The trial Court awarded a sum of Rs.10,80,200/-(Rupees ten lakhs eighty thousand two hundred only) along with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum as compensation to the respondents/petitioners.
The appellant/respondent aggrieved by the above award amount filed an appeal before the High Court.
2. Both the parties entered into negotiation and finally settled the issues arisen between them.

3. In terms of the compromise arrived at between the parties, the appellant/respondent has agreed to pay a sum of Rs.12,60,000/-(Rupees twelve lakhs sixty thousand onlyt) in full quit within 90 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
The respondents/petitioners have already agreed to receive the said amount proportionately as ordered by the trial court.
